concept: Route 53: latency/geoproximity routing + health checks with failover
tests: The Route 53 combination to send users to the nearest healthy Region and fail over automatically.
expected: Latency-based or geoproximity routing records (nearest Region) + Route 53 health checks with failover routing (switch to the secondary Region). Triggers: "nearest healthy regional endpoint", "automatically fail over to another region".
why_not: Weighted with static weights ignores latency/health; a private hosted zone — internal DNS; simple routing has no health-based failover.
